assay: bulk RNA-seq (DNBSEQ/BGISEQ-500, 50-bp SE), gastrocnemius, male mice
sample_inclusion: all 12 deposited samples (3 per genotype x exercise cell)
primary_estimand: acute-exercise (90-min run) effect on gastrocnemius gene expression in WT (fl/fl) mice; the paper's mechanistic question is how cFeimin MKO changes that response (Sln de-repression during exercise)
planned_contrasts: Exe vs Sed within WT (exercise effect; GEO overall_design)
Exe vs Sed within MKO (exercise effect in knockout)
MKO vs WT within Exe and within Sed (genotype effect; abstract: Sln up in MKO during exercise)

paper_threshold.source_locator: GEO GSE280845 data_processing (authors' text): cutoff of log2 fold change (logFC) of +- 1 and a p-value < 0.05

paper_method: DESeq2 (v1.40.2) Wald test with contrast tests on StringTie gene counts (GEO data_processing)
paper_results: No full text: DEG counts not available. Abstract: cFeimin suppresses Sln expression during exercise via FOXC2; so Sln expected higher in MKO than WT after exercise.
